lang.label: Language
home.title: Select crisis event
home.backendHint: Ensure the API is running and the database is ready.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: No reports yet. Submit one from the home page.
report.title: New damage report
report.photoHint: Choose from your gallery or take a new photo.
report.siteConditionHint: How is this place now — damage level, repaired by the community, or cleared/demolished.
report.footprintNote: Blue outlines are known building footprints (batch data). You can report anywhere using GPS and a text landmark — footprints are optional, not required for every address.
report.textLocationHint: Nearby street names, intersections, or landmarks to help others find this spot — add if useful alongside the name above.
report.textLocationPlaceholder: e.g. corner of Main St & 2nd Ave, near central market
report.infraNameHint: The building or place you are reporting on, e.g. Riverside Elementary
report.capturedAtHint: Defaults to the current time; change if you observed damage earlier.
report.siteStatus.label: Site condition now
contribution.mission: Community map — your reports help neighbors and responders.
contribution.empty: Your first report helps others find and track damage.
contribution.noLeaderboard: No rankings or rewards — quality over quantity.
contribution.duplicateWarn: You recently reported this building. Consider updating your earlier report instead of adding another pin.
report.debris: Debris clearing required on or near site
report.err.location: Set a map pin, select a building footprint, or enter a text landmark.
report.err.other: Please specify when "Other" infrastructure is selected.
report.offlineQueued: Saved offline. Will sync when online.
admin.title: Admin
map.location.title: Use your location?
map.location.body: GPS helps center the map. You can always pan, tap the map, or pick a building footprint.
map.locateMe: Place report pin at my GPS
map.hint.new: Tap a building footprint to set location
map.hint.newOpen: Report anywhere — no admin boundary required
map.hint.newPlaceFirst: Tap the map or + to place a pin, then open the form. Use Cancel above to exit.
map.unspecified.hint: Unspecified event — report anywhere. Official area and dates will apply to display after admin setup.
map.offline.reportMode: Offline reporting — new reports will sync when you are back online.
map.offline.downloadHint: This area is not fully downloaded yet. Offline panning may still turn tiles blank.
map.offline.needFirstVisit: Connect once to load the crisis before offline reporting.

map.err.backendSteps: Start the API (port 8000) and ensure the database is reachable. Vite proxies /v1 in dev.
map.legend.title: Legend
map.hint.noMarkers: No reports in this view. Use New or + to report here.
map.hint.noMineInView: None of your reports in this view. Pan the map or use New.
map.legend.clusterNote: Zoom in or tap clusters to expand.
map.locationPanel.title: Location & history
map.locationPanel.browseOnly: View history below. To add another report at this same spot, use the button — the form opens with this location already set.
map.locationPanel.noPlacement: Select a location on the map
map.locationPanel.buildingNoFootprint: Linked to a known building record
map.locationPanel.noBuildingDetected: No footprint here — GPS and text landmark will be saved
map.offline.regionBoxHint: Boxes = downloaded areas (orange dashed = preview before download); blue fill = downloaded.
map.offline.previewBoxHint: Orange dashed box = area that will be saved. Pan the map to target your AOI before downloading.
map.offline.useSavedBody: Tap a saved area below or a blue box on the map to load cached tiles, then report.
map.offline.zoomRangeHint: Selected area opens at z17; zoom freely — gray tiles mean not downloaded there.
map.offline.useSavedHint: You are offline — pick a saved area (map blue box) to start.
map.offline.onlineRestored: Connection is stable again. Switch back to online map mode for latest data.
